## File: pytorch_pytorch/torch/backends/xeon/run_cpu.py

Prompts

```
['run PyTorch inference on Intel Xeon processors with optimized thread and memory configuration', 'launch multi-instance PyTorch inference with specified number of instances and cores per instance', 'get CPU topology information including NUMA nodes, physical cores, and logical cores', 'configure Intel OpenMP preload and tcmalloc or jemalloc memory allocator for PyTorch', 'create an argparse parser with all CLI options for the Intel Xeon CPU launcher']
```

```
{'run_cpu_inference': 'run PyTorch inference on Intel Xeon processors with optimized thread and memory configuration', 'launch_multi_instance_inference': 'launch multi-instance PyTorch inference with specified number of instances and cores per instance', 'get_cpu_topology': 'get CPU topology information including NUMA nodes, physical cores, and logical cores', 'configure_openmp_allocator': 'configure Intel OpenMP preload and tcmalloc or jemalloc memory allocator for PyTorch', 'create_cli_parser': 'create an argparse parser with all CLI options for the Intel Xeon CPU launcher'}
```
